method.client: Node fetch (undici) on loopback; one keep-alive pool; latency = request start to last body byte
method.percentiles: nearest-rank over raw samples; aggregate = median across rounds; spread = min..max of per-round p95
method.rateLimits: distinct X-Forwarded-For per request; requests rotate across 16 bench users with identical memberships
method.caveat: Descriptive baseline on one laptop with other workloads running; not an SLA claim.
